name: We Baby Bears
description: Follow Grizz, Panda and Ice Bear – as their younger baby selves – traveling in a magical box to fantastic new worlds searching for a place to call home. Along the way, they meet new friends, learn a few lessons and discover that “home” can mean wherever they are, as long as they’re together.

videos.title: The Magical Box
videos.overview: Three baby bear brothers are granted a magical box that can transport them to any place in the universe.

videos.title: Bears and the Beanstalk
videos.overview: The Bears work as short-order cooks in a giant’s diner.

videos.title: Boo-Dunnit
videos.overview: While visiting a mansion haunted by ghosts, the Bears must play detective to find out which one of them stole their box.

videos.title: The Little Mer-Bear
videos.overview: The Bears work as short-order cooks in a giant’s diner.

videos.title: Modern-ish Stone Age Family
videos.overview: The Bears are invited to live with a family of cavemen, but things get rocky when the Bears teach the family about television.

videos.title: Excalibear
videos.overview: The Bears visit a medieval vegetable village and Grizz is convinced he’s the rightful king.

videos.title: Meat House
videos.overview: The Bears and their new friend, Squatter Otter, take up residence in a mysterious house made of meat.

videos.title: The Pirate Parrot Polly
videos.overview: The Bears team up with Polly the Parrot Pirate on a quest for hidden treasure.

videos.title: Baby Bear Genius
videos.overview: Baby geniuses want Ice Bear to attend their prestigious school, but without Grizz and Panda.

videos.title: Bug City Sleuths
videos.overview: The Bears become noir-style detectives to live in a city inhabited by bugs.

videos.title: Hashtag #1 Fan
videos.overview: Panda gets kidnapped by a pair of deranged French foxes.

videos.title: Snow Place Like Home
videos.overview: When the Bears realize whatever they build with snow comes to life they decide to build the biggest snow party of all time.

videos.title: Fiesta Day
videos.overview: The Bears party it up with a living piñatas for Fiesta Day. Wanting the festivities to never end, Grizz wishes for it to be Fiesta Day everyday.

videos.title: Baba Yaga House
videos.overview: Squatter Otter tries to win Panda's trust and convince the Bears to live in a mysterious house.

videos.title: Bears in the Dark
videos.overview: The Bears search for their missing box in a dark and scary cave.

videos.title: Big Trouble Little Babies
videos.overview: When they realize they’re too small for the rides at an amusement park, the Bears use a magic potion to get bigger.

videos.title: Triple T Tigers
videos.overview: When the Bears meet three cool tiger brothers, Grizz wants to be just like the oldest, TK, but he may not be the best role model.

videos.title: Panda’s Family
videos.overview: While exploring a lantern festival, the Bears encounter Panda’s long-lost family.

videos.title: A Tale of Two Ice Bears
videos.overview: The Bears accidentally clone Ice Bear and Ice Bear has a hard time adjusting.

videos.title: Unica
videos.overview: The Bears join forces with Unica, the ultimate forest protector.

videos.title: Sheep Bears
videos.overview: The Bears get jobs as sheep herders on an idyllic farm.

videos.title: Ice Bear's Pet
videos.overview: Ice Bear attempts to keep a giant owl-monster secretly as a pet.

videos.title: Dragon Pests
videos.overview: The Bears and Squatter Otter crash a couple's swanky pad while they're out of town.

videos.title: No Land, All Air!
videos.overview: The Bears find themselves in a world of dog fighting planes and floating airships.

videos.title: Tooth Fairy Tech
videos.overview: In order to earn enough money to buy a house, the Bears work as tooth fairies.

videos.title: High Baby Fashion
videos.overview: The Bears enter Panda into a fashion contest, but he's got some fierce competition when Madam Malin and Madeline show up!

videos.title: Teddi Bear
videos.overview: In an endless junkyard, the Bears meet Teddi, a sentient teddy bear.

videos.title: A Gross Worm
videos.overview: The Bears help Unica return an endangered alien worm to its home.

videos.title: A  Real Crayon
videos.overview: The Bears find a mysterious crayon that has the power to make anything they draw become REAL.

videos.title: Witches
videos.overview: The Bears accidentally summon three mysterious witches and have to figure out how to get them back home.

videos.title: Happy Bouncy Fun Town
videos.overview: The Bears land in the cheeriest place of all time, but Ice Bear starts to feel out of place.

videos.title: Back to Our Regular Time Period
videos.overview: The Bears find themselves trapped in the wrong time period.

videos.title: Bath on the Nile
videos.overview: The Bears find themselves in an ancient Egyptian spa, but Grizz refuses to take a bath.

videos.title: Bubble Fields
videos.overview: The Bears try to prove to Unica that they can be expert bubble-ologists.

videos.title: Who Crashed the RV?
videos.overview: When Squatter Otter finds his new RV destroyed, each bear tells their own version of what happened.

videos.title: Temple Bears
videos.overview: The Bears search for a house key in a puzzle-filled temple.

videos.title: Lighthouse
videos.overview: The Bears find a lighthouse powered by a luminous creature.

videos.title: Doll's House
videos.overview: The Bears apply to be roommates in a fantastic dream dollhouse.

videos.title: Little Fallen Star
videos.overview: The Bears travel to the far reaches of space to discover the origin of their magic box.

videos.title: The Big Wish
videos.overview: The bears set off on new adventures with Box being able to transport them anywhere they wish. But what if Box could make their own choices? Would Box even stick around with the bears? If only there were a magical way to find out.

videos.title: Polly's New Crew
videos.overview: The bears reunite with their old friend Polly the Pirate Captain. They soon learn that Polly is under the effect of a pirate curse and need to help them overcome it.

videos.title: Bug City Frame Up
videos.overview: While revisiting Bug CIty, the bears are accused of crimes they didn't commit. Ice Bear must team up with old friend Sam Spider Spade to help prove the bears innocence.

videos.title: The Great Veggie War
videos.overview: The bears return to the Veggie Kingdom to visit their old friend Lima, only to find the kingdom at war with a familiar yet unexpected foe. Can the bears help save the veggie kingdom from total annihilation?

videos.title: Unica's House
videos.overview: The bears learn about sleepovers when visiting Unica in her hometown.

videos.title: Rexford's Nectar
videos.overview: In an effort to be a conscious consumer, Panda becomes obsessed with a new eco-friendly product.

videos.title: Grizz's Doc
videos.overview: Unica and the bears enter into Glitterwood's annual bake off while Grizz documents it.

videos.title: Triple T Tiger Lilies
videos.overview: It's time to grow the best flowers in Glitterwood forest! But Unica and the bears soon realize that they're all thumbs, and none of them are green! When the Triple T Tigers show off their awesome tiger lily, Unica and the bears decide it's time to do whatever it takes to grow their own awesome flower. But short cuts and bad decisions soon result in a disaster of gigantic proportion!

videos.title: After Bedtime
videos.overview: Ice Bear sneaks away after hours to right a wrong.

videos.title: The Parade
videos.overview: Unica is half donkey and half unicorn, and doesn't know which float to ride in the heritage parade. The bears volunteer to help her choose.

videos.title: The Big Bloom
videos.overview: Unica and the bears prepare to rock out in order to help the Grand Magnolia Tree bloom.

videos.title: Return to the Sea
videos.overview: The bears catch up with their old chum Farah who teaches them about the dangers of the ocean.

videos.title: Shark!
videos.overview: Get your motors running, well, maybe not motors, but fins! Grizz heads out on the undersea highway when he befriends a sputtering, high-octane shark.

videos.title: Sunken Sub
videos.overview: In an effort to speed up their journey to Atlantis, Panda pilots a submarine.

videos.title: Flounder Fam
videos.overview: Farah is embarrassed by her inability to fit in with her family. Ice Bear trains her in the art of camouflage.

videos.title: Land World
videos.overview: The bears enjoy the comforts of dry land at Farah's favorite childhood destination. But Land World isn't as amazing as Farah remembered.

videos.title: Bermuda Baby Bears
videos.overview: Farah and the bears uncover the secrets of the Bermuda Triangle.

videos.title: Welcome to Atlantis
videos.overview: The gang arrives in Atlantis hoping that Mr. Mollusk can restore color to Box and the ocean.

videos.title: Three Bears and a Dippy
videos.overview: Ursa puts the three bears in charge of babysitting Dippy.

videos.title: Space Beach
videos.overview: A beach, in space! It's exactly what it sounds like. The bears, Dippy and Box all enjoy some fun in the suns along with, wait, grumpy aunt Cassi!?

videos.title: Black Hole
videos.overview: Panda's creative genius knows no limits! Too bad his brothers can't seem to appreciate that. If only Panda could find someone who's on his level.

videos.title: Uncle Orion
videos.overview: With the bear's help, Dippy's Uncle Orion enters a space race.

videos.title: The Wish Cannon
videos.overview: Dippy and the bears help prepare for Rigel's baby shower.

videos.title: Intergalactic Party Crashers
videos.overview: The bears throw Rigal a baby shower! Unfortunately, the party is soon taken over by a group of evil space pirates!

videos.title: First Day of Art School
videos.overview: Panda pursues his dream by enrolling in art school.

videos.title: Intermediate Photography
videos.overview: Grizz discovers a magical camera that can predict the future! But when he takes a picture of himself, he finds its prediction to be quite grave.

videos.title: Independent Study: Mass Appeal
videos.overview: In preparation of the big art critique, Panda, along with his new friend Nori, rely on internet comments to make their work as likable as possible.

videos.title: Advanced Ceramics
videos.overview: Ice Bear struggles with perfection in an advanced ceramics class.

videos.title: Graduation Day
videos.overview: It's graduation day, and the bears are not prepared.

videos.title: Blarfenpleepo
videos.overview: Everything is perfect for the bears in the town of Flumenblurgen, until a certain pair of villainous foxes make their return.

videos.title: Grizz Island
videos.overview: Grizz finds himself alone on an island.

videos.title: Panda Goes West
videos.overview: After a dastardly mishap with Malin's teleportation cannon, Panda finds himself transported to a cowboy world inhabited by cacti folk.

videos.title: Ice Bear vs Cyber City
videos.overview: Ice Bear must traverse a dangerous city alongside a sworn enemy to reunite with his bros.

videos.title: The Box and the Fox
videos.overview: Madeline and Box settle into Flumenblurgen when the bears and Malin arrive.
